title: Personality Traits
body:
Syntax: (chosen once, permanently, at character creation)

Description: Your personality trait gives a real, permanent trade-off to two of your combat stats -- one genuine upside, one genuine downside. There are 8 to choose from:

&CReckless&x -- more damage, weaker armor class.
&CConfident&x -- better hit roll, worse dodge chance.
&CLoyal&x -- +10% experience whenever you're fighting alongside others (any real group, not just a formal team) -- this stacks with the team bonus. Fighting alone is completely ordinary, no bonus and no penalty.
&CReserved&x -- better dodge chance, less damage.
&CCalm&x -- stronger armor class, worse hit roll.
&CHot-headed&x -- better critical chance, worse hit roll.
&CCunning&x -- better critical chance, weaker armor class.
&CCheerful&x -- better dodge chance, worse critical chance.

Chosen once at character creation and permanent -- there's no way to change it afterward.

Date: 2026-09-05
